shortDescription: Register or Remove a client node and set its configuration in IBM Storage Protect

options.name: admin_user_id
options.description: Administrative user ID with client owner authority or 'NONE' (the default value).

options.name: archive_repl_rule_default
options.description: Default rule for archive replication.

options.name: authentication_method
options.description: Authentication method for the node.

options.name: auto_rename_file_spaces
options.description: Specifies whether file spaces should be automatically renamed.

options.name: backup_initiation
options.description: Specifies backup initiation type.

options.name: backup_repl_rule_default
options.description: Default rule for backup replication.

options.name: can_archive_delete
options.description: Specifies whether the node can delete archived data.

options.name: can_backup_delete
options.description: Specifies whether the node can delete backed-up data.

options.name: compression
options.description: Defines whether the node compresses files before sending them to the server.

options.name: data_read_path
options.description: Defines the data read path.

options.name: data_write_path
options.description: Defines the data write path.

options.name: deduplication
options.description: Enables deduplication for the node.

options.name: email
options.description: Email address associated with the node.

options.name: force_password_reset
options.description: Forces a password reset on the node upon the next login.

options.name: keep_mount_points
options.description: Specifies if mount points should persist after use.

options.name: max_mount_points
options.description: Maximum number of mount points for the node. The default value is 1. You can specify an integer in the range 0 - 999.

options.name: max_transaction_group
options.description: Maximum number of objects in a single transaction group. The default value is 0. Specifying 0 indicates that the node uses the server global value that is set in the server options file. To use a value other than the server global value, specify a value in the range 4 - 65000.

options.name: min_extent_size
options.description: Minimum size of extents in KB (50, 250, or 750).

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the node to register or deregister

options.name: node_contact
options.description: Contact information for the node, up to 255 characters.

options.name: node_password
options.description: Specifies the client node password If you authenticate passwords locally with the IBM Storage Protect server, you must specify a password. The minimum length of the password is 15 characters unless a different value is specified by using the SET MINPWLENGTH command. The maximum length of the password is 64 characters.

options.name: node_password_expiry
options.description: Specifies the number of days the password remains valid You can set the password expiration period 0 - 9999 days. A value of 0 means that the password never expires. If you do not specify this parameter, the server common-password expiration period is used which is 90 days unless changed.

options.name: node_type
options.description: Specifies the type of node being registered. System default is 'Client'.

options.name: option_set
options.description: Client option set to be used by the node.

options.name: password
options.description: Password for your IBM Storage Protect instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_PASSWORD)

options.name: policy_domain
options.description: The policy domain to assign the node to. Default is 'STANDARD'.

options.name: recover_damaged
options.description: Specifies if the node should recover damaged objects.

options.name: replication_state
options.description: Controls the replication state for the node.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Specify the timeout Ansible should use in requests to the IBM Storage Protect host. Defaults to 10s, but this is handled by the shared module_utils code If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT)

options.name: role_override
options.description: Specifies the role override.

options.name: schedules
options.description: The name of the exising schedules to associate with the node

options.name: server_name
options.description: SERVERNAME your IBM Storage Protect instance as specified in the dsm.sys. If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_SERVERNAME) If value not specified by any means, the value of C(local) will be used

options.name: session_client_ip
options.description: Specifies the client IP address that the server contacts to initiate scheduled events. Matches to the HLAddress Parameter for the dsmadmc CLI.

options.name: session_client_port
options.description: Specifies the client port number on which the client listens for sessions from the server. Matches to the LLAddress Parameter for the dsmadmc CLI.

options.name: session_initiation
options.description: Determines whether the session is initiated by the client or server.

options.name: session_security
options.description: Specifies whether the node must use the most secure settings to communicate with an IBM Storage Protect server. The system will default to "transitional"

options.name: space_repl_rule_default
options.description: Default rule for space replication.

options.name: split_large_objects
options.description: Specifies if large objects should be split during backup.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the registration. States 'present' and 'registered' have the same effect. States 'absent', 'deregistered' and 'removed' have the same effect.

options.name: target_level
options.description: Specifies the target replication level for the node. The parameter applies only to nodes with a type of CLIENT. {'You can substitute an applicable release package for Version.Release.Modification.Fix (V.R.M.F) Level. For example': 'TARGETLevel=7.1.0.0.'}

options.name: url
options.description: URL associated with the node.

options.name: username
options.description: Username for your IBM Storage Protect instance. If value not set, will try environment variable C(STORAGE_PROTECT_USERNAME)

options.name: utility_url
options.description: Utility URL for the node.
